(3) Location: the role is in Bangalore, India, under a 25% in-office hybrid policy, and it requires travel within India/APAC and enterprise experience in India/APAC. It is not US-based and not designated Remote, while Ananya is in Boston, MA and willing to relocate only within the US. (4) Skills: the only specific technology named is Python ('Comfortable with Python'), which is fewer than 2 named technologies, so the skills test is skipped. Python is in her shipped list in any case. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic states 'We do sponsor visas!', so sponsorship is not a blocker. Even so, the failures on role type, seniority, and location make this NOT_RELEVANT.
